tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Curated places in Fulham, optionally filtered by category, use-case tag or featured picks. Each result links to its https://knowfulham.com/place/{slug} page. rankedUrl is https://knowfulham.com/best/{category} for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop, and https://knowfulham.com/best for every

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full record for one Fulham place by slug: the guide's description and tip, address, coordinates, opening hours, website and the public /place URL. Use it for hours or an address, and for the coordinates of a station or landmark before calling nearby_places. openNow says whether the place is open at

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Nearest curated Fulham places to a WGS84 coordinate, with distance in metres. For places near a station or another place in the guide, take the coordinate from get_place (stations are places in category transport) and filter by category here.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Filter curated Fulham places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked the same way as the published best-of lists. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours and websites are not included, so call get_place for them. It cannot filter by opening hours: for what i

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Side-by-side sourced records for 2 to 4 Fulham places by slug, with the tags they share. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One published Fulham guide by slug: its introduction and its ranked places, every field sourced. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_place, search_places · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_place, search_places · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
